subject: Next steps & MAP draft after Friday call — milestones, owners, target close
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@acme.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP (draft) — Acme Robotics

Hi Olivia —

Great to meet the team on Friday. Quick recap and a draft Mutual Action Plan attached for your review (ACME_MAP_v0.9.xlsx). I captured the milestones we discussed and proposed owners; please review and flag any changes. High-level items: 

- Target commercial close: 2026-05-01 (T+11 weeks) — flexible per procurement timeline
- Technical evaluation (POC): week of 2026-03-01 — owner: Samir Roy (Acme IT) / Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood SE)
- Security & compliance review: deliver SOC2 evidence, data residency Q/A — owner: Acme Security / Redwood Security team (cc'd Vivek)
- Procurement & contract review: finish redlines and signature — owner: procurement@acme.com / Rishi Malhotra (Redwood Sales Ops)
- Pilot success criteria: 95th pct latency under 250ms for 50 RPS, cost target < $0.08/token (TBD)

Dependencies called out in the MAP: 
- Access to a representative dataset and sample traffic profile for benchmark runs
- Completion of Acme security questionnaire (I attached the current MAP and a checklist)

Next steps I propose: 
1) You confirm owners and the target close window (accept, shorten, or extend)
2) Samir to share an internal SOW for the POC and a point of contact for IT access
3) Rishi and I to align on procurement cadence and draft contract milestones

Can we schedule a 30-min weekly checkpoint starting the week of Feb 16 to keep things moving? I attached the MAP draft and added an open column for comments.

Thanks — looking forward to your notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: ACME_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)]

From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Roy <samir.roy@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP (draft) — Acme Robotics

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. A few quick items from our side: 

- Procurement would like to accelerate contract conversations — can we aim to have commercial terms agreed by Apr 15 instead of May 1? That would allow us to budget for Q2 rollout.
- Tech: I'm looping Samir as the IT lead for the POC. Samir — can you confirm resource availability for the week of Mar 1 and whether you need anything from Redwood in advance?
- Security: our security team will run through the questionnaire. They asked if you can provide the SOC2 Type II report and a brief note on data retention defaults for hosted vs. private deploys.

I've attached an annotated MAP spreadsheet with a few edits (ACME_requested_edits.xlsx). I moved the procurement milestone earlier and added our internal sign-off steps.

If you can update the MAP to reflect Apr 15 target close and return the file, we'll review on our side and confirm owners. Weekly sync starting Feb 16 sounds good — can we do Tuesdays at 11:00 ET?

Thanks,
Olivia Hart
Head of Product Ops | Acme Robotics
olivia.hart@acme.com
[Attachment: ACME_requested_edits.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + MAP (draft) — Acme Robotics

Marissa / Rishi —

Saw Olivia's comments. Quick internal notes before I reply to Acme: 

- I can take the SE owner role for the POC workstream. I'll prepare an environment plan and an access checklist for Samir (estimate 3 business days to produce).
- SOC2: we have the latest report, I'll pull a redacted copy to attach. Also documenting our data retention options (hosted default 90 days logs, option to configure retention in Private deployments).
- Procurement acceleration to Apr 15 might be tight but doable if procurement can review and respond to redlines within 10 business days after we send initial contract. Rishi, can you draft a milestone that supports a compressed timeline?

I'll draft a short reply to Olivia with an updated MAP attached (v1.2) that reflects the Apr 15 target and adds my SE owner details.

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Internal note]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@acme.com>
Cc: Samir Roy <samir.roy@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP update + weekly checkpoint invite (Tue 11:00 ET) — Acme Robotics

Hi Olivia —

Following up with the updated Mutual Action Plan attached (ACME_MAP_v1.2.xlsx). Changes vs. v0.9: 

- Target close date updated to 2026-04-15 per your request
- Procurement milestone moved earlier; added expected 10 business day turnaround for redlines
- SE owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) added for POC tasks; Samir listed as Acme IT owner
- Security deliverables: SOC2 (redacted) attached, plus data retention options and sample audit log extract (high level)
- Added a weekly checkpoint row (Tuesdays 11:00 ET) with agenda and owner for meeting management

Current outstanding items (please confirm in the next 48 hours):
1) Samir — confirm IT availability for week of Mar 1 and whether you need an access sprint before the POC
2) Procurement — confirm internal review window and a primary contact for contract redlines
3) Security — confirm receipt of the redacted SOC2 and whether a deeper security call is required

I've also created a shared folder with the MAP and supporting docs: https://drive.redwood.example.com/s/ACME-MAP-2026.

If I don't hear back by Tue EOD (Feb 16), I'll assume the Apr 15 target is acceptable and will schedule the weekly checkpoints starting Feb 17 per your TZ preference.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_redacted.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
